text:
### Mission  
Identify, measure, and manage enterprise risks to protect the bank's capital and franchise.
name: Chunk 52/102

raw_entities.name: Enterprise Risk Management Function
raw_entities.description: The organizational function responsible for identifying, measuring, and managing enterprise risks across the bank to protect capital and franchise value. This represents the core risk governance structure.
context: Identify, measure, and manage enterprise risks to protect the bank's capital and franchise

raw_entities.name: Enterprise Risk
raw_entities.description: A core banking concept representing any threat or uncertainty that could impact the bank's capital adequacy, operational continuity, or franchise value. Enterprise risks are systematically identified, measured, and managed.
context: Identify, measure, and manage enterprise risks to protect the bank's capital and franchise

raw_entities.name: Bank Capital
raw_entities.description: The financial resources and equity of the bank that serve as a buffer against losses and are protected through enterprise risk management activities.
context: protect the bank's capital and franchise

raw_entities.name: Bank Franchise
raw_entities.description: The long-term value and reputation of the bank as a going concern, encompassing customer relationships, market position, and operational capability that must be protected through risk management.
context: protect the bank's capital and franchise
